hooks.name: AI-DLC secret scan (advisory)
hooks.description: Advisory guardrail: before a write/publish tool runs, remind Kiro to confirm no secrets/credentials are in the payload and that the human approved THIS artifact. Injects a prompt; does not block. To make it blocking, change action.type to 'command' and exit non-zero on a violation.

action.prompt: AI-DLC guardrail check before this action: (1) Confirm the payload contains no tokens, passwords, API keys, or credentials. (2) Confirm the human explicitly approved writing THIS specific artifact to THIS destination (draft -> approve -> publish). If either is not satisfied, stop and ask the human before proceeding.
